description: This PHP source file defines the BasicAuthListener class, which listens for HTTP request events and enforces basic authentication for private zones within the Goteo application. It handles authorization checks and responds with appropriate HTTP responses when authentication fails.

classes.name: BasicAuthListener
classes.description: Listener class for handling basic HTTP authentication on specific routes within the Goteo application.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Handles the request event, checks the request URI against public/private route configurations, processes HTTP basic auth, and sets the response accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the kernel request event to the onRequest handler.
